test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MOBILE' is coded as BJFZLK and 'TABLET' is coded as QCIZXR. How will 'KINDLE' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Subtraction of (3) and (2) alternately from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'MOBILE' is coded as BJFZLK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c892a2dc1f0e4bb13d7a8e18a4874c5f4786514501f36bcadf5e1b40bc044191.png] 

And,

 
• 'TABLET' is coded as QCIZXR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b71436bbb6f244e1e63a3806ddd6e2da7d5942ecdf874f0aee21497060c97ce3.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'KINDLE' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dcdb608db170582c80d70eaeb8daa6343817ef81d4cff3f99ceef5709e20753.png] 

​Hence, "**BJALFI**" is the correct answer.

40
